headline: Level eases to SITCON 3; MSP remote access under attack (N-central, ScreenConnect); OpenSSH SSHole KEV due today, Barracuda ESG 11-13

bullets.text: Changed: SITCON eased from 2 to 3 (ELEVATED) with no new reports since the last sweep; the week now runs 1.05x the 90-day average, down from 1.17x. Six exploited flaws reached CISA KEV in three working days.

MSP tooling remains the top target: N-able took its N-central remote access service offline after a researcher published dozens of zero-days (6 outlets), and active ScreenConnect attacks have breached MSPs and dozens of organizations.

KEV due today, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited on Linux), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779, IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218. Due 11-13: recently patched Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets), Ivanti CVE-2026-104935.

Also exploited: critical Xen Orchestra flaws (3 outlets; no CVEs in the brief); Qlik Sense servers hit with reverse shells while attackers stage ActiveMQ and Veeam exploits; Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave CVE-2026-111793 (KEV due 11-24).

Breaches and ransomware: Maersk confirmed a breach as WhiteArmor demands $5 million; Vanderbilt University on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); Baker Tilly third-party breach; Credit Mutuel Arkea says €100m missing; Poland shut down its ePUAP platform after a cyberattack.

State activity: France blames Iran for sabotage of refrigeration controllers at about 700 retail sites (5 outlets); ESET links Cereal to Turla in a Romanian server breach (5 outlets). Cloud: AntiFox AI agents used to steal AWS credentials; GSocket abused for stealthy C2.

actions: Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
MSPs and customers: keep N-central access restricted until N-able's fixes land, patch ScreenConnect and review its sessions and access logs.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 by 11-13 and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure and Citrix.
Keep Xen Orchestra off the internet; check Qlik Sense, ActiveMQ and Veeam servers for reverse shells and unexpected processes.
Audit internet-exposed OT controllers such as refrigeration and building systems; change default credentials and remove direct exposure.
Review AWS keys and CloudTrail for unusual use, hunt for GSocket on Linux, and patch Outlook, Chrome, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave by 11-24.
